sample_unit: LLM responses to IBS dietary questions

links.outcome: Compliance of LLM dietary responses with IBS clinical guidelines (Guideline Compliance Score)
links.effect: ChatGPT 70% and Gemini 57.5% of responses guideline-compliant; no significant difference between models (p > 0.05), so a substantial share of responses were noncompliant.
links.quote: This study found that most responses from ChatGPT (70%) and Gemini (57.5%) were compliant with the guidelines, but there was no significant difference in guideline compliance, quality, understandability, actionability, or readability scores (p > 0.05).

screen.reason: Evaluates the performance, readability, and guideline compliance of ChatGPT and Google Gemini for IBS dietary advice using benchmark scoring tools without testing a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
